comparison.objective: Fit and lock a split cable guide, then verify service-drawer travel.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual retrofit around an existing cable, guide seating, keeper latching and clearance verification.
comparison.success_condition: Guide locked before release, drawer travels at least 48 mm, sleeve clears, plugs stay seated and hands remain clear.
comparison.reason: Tests assembly insertion/latching and a functional travel proof; no sacrificial notch fracture, hammering or loose-fragment recovery.
